Internal pure function SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b) returns (uint c); safe addition with require(c >= a).
Internal pure function SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b) returns (uint c); safe subtraction with require(b <= a).
Internal pure function SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b) returns (uint c); safe multiplication with overflow check.
Internal pure function SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b) returns (uint c); safe division with require(b > 0).
Constructor of Owned; sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner; sets newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(); requires msg.sender == newOwner and transfers ownership.
Constructor of Regium; initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply, and assigns balances[owner].
Regium.totalSupply() view returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
Regium.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view returns balances[tokenOwner].
Regium.transfer(address to, uint tokens); transfers tokens from msg.sender to to using SafeMath.
Regium.approve(address spender, uint tokens); sets allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Regium.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens); transfers tokens using allowance.
Regium.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Regium.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data); approves and calls receiveApproval on spender.
Fallback function; reverts all ETH sent.
Regium.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner; transfers arbitrary ERC20 tokens to owner.
Interface function receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data); called externally by approveAndCall.
Untrusted input msg.sender; used for authorization and token operations.
External call in Regium.approveAndCall to arbitrary spender.receiveApproval; potential reentrancy/callback.
External call in Regium.transferAnyERC20Token to arbitrary tokenAddress.transfer; onlyOwner guarded.
Arithmetic operation in Regium.constructor: _totalSupply = 7200000 * 10**uint(decimals); potential integer overflow/underflow.
